description: This file defines the 'Salary' data transfer object class within the OrangeHRM project, used for handling salary display fields in reports. It includes methods for converting data to array format and mapping fields to getter methods, and it utilizes traits and other DTO classes.

classes.name: Salary
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object representing salary-related display fields for reports, capable of normalizing salary data based on provided fields and employee number.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Salary DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Retrieves employee salary data and normalizes it into an array based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping of DTO fields to their corresponding getter methods.
